Esta novedosa herramienta fue originada en el Departamento de Pediatría por el Dr. José Miguel Suescún Vargas, en la Escuela de Medicina y Ciencias de la Salud de la Universidad del Rosario en Bogotá, Colombia; se encuentra orientada para el uso tanto de pediatras, especialistas pediátricos, médicos familiares y médicos generales, como de residentes, internos y estudiantes de medicina. Esta app cuenta con una interfaz muy intuitiva que, por medio del peso, edad y estado de hidratación del niño o niña, permite orientar el plan de hidratación a utilizar y los diferentes volúmenes a emplear para reestablecer el estado hídrico en un paciente específico. Igualmente tiene la posibilidad de programar alarmas para recordar al usuario médico la supervisión del plan empleado en cada uno de los niños o niñas en tratamiento hídrico; permitiendo también, acceder a tablas de apoyo y referencias bibliográficas, como instrumentos adicionales de ayuda.

Anyone can get breast cancer, but there’s a lot we can do to stop it. Checking your breasts for changes each month is free, easy and might save your life.

Download the FREE DearMamma app to learn how to self-check and take control of your breast health.

Check your breasts. Save your life.

Why? Because early detection and treatment is the single greatest factor in successful recovery.

Regular mammograms are great, but you can lower your risks further still by learning the warning signs and scheduling a monthly self-check. It’s the best way to get to know what is normal for you, and will help you notice changes more quickly. The faster you notice, the sooner you'll be able to react and get treatment if needed.

WHAT CAN YOU DO WITH DEAR MAMMA?

Learn how to self-check – Watch our easy-to-follow pictorial and video guides. You can view them as many times as you need until you get the feel of it.

No mirror, no problem – Easy options to use your phone as a mirror while carrying out your self-check, and get a better view of what you’re doing.

Set reminders – Schedule reminders that work for you, then sit back and relax until the app prompts you for your next check.

Track your history – Store notes or audio comments after each check, to help you keep track of changes over time.

Listen up – Read-aloud functionality means you can go hands-free while self-checking.

Customise your experience – Everybody is different. Choose from a variety of skin-tones to match what you want to see.

Learn about the importance of early detection – Hear from oncologists, religious leaders and breast cancer advocates worldwide about the importance of self-checks

Offline access – Don’t worry about the app using all your internet data. Once you’ve installed the app on your phone, it doesn’t need any WiFi connection to run.

Broad support – Endorsed by scientific, religious and societal leaders alike.

Non-commercial – DearMamma is free! We don’t charge, and we never will. Nor will you see any ads.
